import sqlite3
import json
from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)
db_path = 'internal_data.db'

@app.route('/submit_form', methods=['POST'])
def submit_form():
    data = request.json
    name = data.get('name', '')
    email = data.get('email', '')
    bio = data.get('bio', '')
    
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Insert user data into the database
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (name, email, bio) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{bio}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return json.dumps({'status': 'success', 'message': 'Data inserted'}), 200

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
